info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking It Management System Development By System Development Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the update of banking IT management system development records using unique system development identifiers. It allows users to modify existing entries to reflect changes in system specifications, features, or project statuses. Typical consumers include banking IT departments, project managers, and development teams seeking to maintain up-to-date system information. The PATCH operation ensures efficient adjustments without the need for complete data resubmission.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specified system development resource identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary fields in the request to modify the resource's attributes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to update the resource identified by RES-100045 in the IT management system, allowing users to modify specific attributes of the system development resource. The payload must adhere to the specified schema to ensure proper processing of the update.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
